hypothesis: H35 (primary, preregistered knowledge/19): adding directed tip continuation (T) AND the H34 RESMAG-FLEX depth-sliced potential-field block (R) to the incumbent BDE+7 HGB detector raises hide-and-recover DTI at fixed emission (sapd2.4, kfrac 0.035). H34-1 (R alone, knowledge/18) is the session's first, negative experiment.
mechanism: R: FFT upward-continuation residuals of RTP (400 m / 1200 m) + conductive-base flexure ridge locate subsurface potential-field edges of faults buried under cover with no scarp. T: directed continuation beyond visible catalogue endpoints locates fault tips/relay gaps (Faulds & Hinz settings in knowledge/03/09). The HGB combines them with DEM/LiDAR + thermal + catalogue geometry; emission is frozen so the contrast is detector-only.
non_fault_process_that_could_mimic_it: R: lithologic contacts and lava-flow/intrusion margins (identical magnetic edges without faulting), depositional basin-margin pinch-out (base gradient ridge without a fault), survey levelling lineaments. T: catalogue fragmentation/digitisation endpoints (map artefacts, not fault tips); the holdout also rewards reconnecting hidden catalogue segments, which genuinely-new faults may not resemble (hug mean +0.0176, within the +0.10 guard).
